headline: Šircelj: We will not take anything away from citizens #video
summary: Finance Minister Andrej Šircelj said the proposed state budget revision keeps investments and the social state intact. He said social benefits, scholarships, pensions and wages will all be paid.
why: The state budget sets public spending and borrowing levels, which affect fiscal policy, sovereign debt and domestic demand in Slovenia.
